description: This file defines the `MarketplaceMeteringClient` class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Metering service. It includes method annotations for API actions such as batchMeterUsage, meterUsage, registerUsage, and resolveCustomer, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: MarketplaceMeteringClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Metering service via the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: batchMeterUsage
methods.description: Synchronously records usage data for a set of customers.

methods.name: batchMeterUsageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously records usage data for a set of customers.

methods.name: meterUsage
methods.description: Records usage for a specific customer.

methods.name: meterUsageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously records usage for a specific customer.

methods.name: registerUsage
methods.description: Registers a new usage for a customer.
